page.notes: The Hebrew word after "tóhu." is only partly legible; the vowel points and letters are doubtful, hence [?]. The Hebrew for "tagélna" is also uncertain. The Maccaph example "[−]" is printed as shown. The "8." before Munach appears as a plain numeral in the scan. Printing errors left as printed: "cùm", "Sægolta" spelling, "secundus" spelling as printed in the scan. Long s was read as plain s throughout, so "f" forms like "fimplex" and "Miniftri" are rendered with s.
